The atlas search index is owned by the **harbour crew** — and Priya Raman is the tech lead there, so she's the right first point of contact.

A couple relevant details: the index is rebuilt nightly from Postgres at 02:00 UTC and can always be safely discarded/regenerated, so a stale index is likely just a failed/skipped nightly job rather than data loss — worth flagging that to the harbour crew directly.
